package.name: gz_buoyancy
package.description:
Gazebo's Buoyancy system with marked collisions: a link marks the collisions that displace water with gz:buoyancy="true" and floats by those alone, under whatever name its model was spawned, so a world shared by many vehicles never has to name them in an <enable> list. A world that only describes the fluid adds <enable_by_default>false</enable_by_default>.
The change is upstream in gz-sim (commit 229ec07e); this package carries it, vendored, until a Gazebo release that ships it reaches ROS. See PROVENANCE.md, including for when to retire it.
